title: Claim research-and-development tax incentives
summary: Identify the research-and-development tax incentives available to the company, document eligible work and expenditure, prepare the claim and retain the supporting evidence. Apply a payroll offset only where the relevant regime provides one.

parts.title: Confirm eligibility and pick a study provider
parts.guidance: Describe the projects, research activities, entity structure, tax year and prior credit claims for the tax adviser’s initial assessment. Compare study providers on methodology, substantiation, review responsibility and fees. Identify eligibility questions and possible elections before commissioning the study. Startup status or product development alone does not establish qualifying research or an available credit.

execution.rationale: Compare credit-study providers and prepare eligibility questions from the supplied projects and prior claims for tax advice.

parts.title: Pull payroll and qualifying-expenditure data for the study
parts.guidance: Tie requested payroll, time allocations, contractor agreements, supply costs and technical records to the relevant business components and period. Distinguish documented activity from estimates needing explanation, and reconcile expenses to the books. Ask the people who performed or recorded the work to resolve gaps. Give the study team traceable activity and expense evidence for evaluating which costs qualify.

geoResolutions.label: Scope the qualified research expenses (QREs) the Form 6765 instructions define — wages, supplies, contract research
The Forschungszulage counts qualifying R&D wages — 25% refunded, more for SMEs since 2024
SR&ED counts qualified R&D salaries and materials, defended with project records

execution.rationale: Reconcile supplied payroll, activity and expense records into traceable study schedules with estimates identified.

parts.title: Provider computes the credit and drafts the claim forms
parts.guidance: Reconcile the technical study, qualified-expense analysis and credit calculation for the filing year. Ask the provider to explain exclusions, the chosen method, group issues and proposed elections. Check the draft claim forms and schedules against that analysis and the books. Resolve unsupported assumptions or inconsistent amounts before the claim enters the return-review process.

geoResolutions.label: The claim is Form 6765, drafted against the study for the filing year
The merged SME/RDEC relief is claimed on the CT600, with a mandatory additional-information form before the claim
Two steps: the BSFZ project certificate first, then the allowance claim prepared for the tax return via ELSTER
The CIR (30% of qualifying spend, plus the CII for innovation) is computed for the corporate tax return
SIFIDE II rests on ANI's annual certification of the qualifying R&D; the credit is computed for the Modelo 22
SR&ED is computed on prescribed forms for the T2, with CCPCs earning the enhanced refundable rate

execution.rationale: The finance owner exchanges study inputs and questions with the R&D provider digitally, then reviews the delivered study and its outstanding assumptions.

parts.title: Review the study and credit amount
parts.guidance: Verify the study’s technical descriptions, expense allocations and exclusions with the people who know the work and records. Review the method, substantiation and proposed elections with the tax adviser, including any payroll-credit treatment. Resolve discrepancies and retain the reviewed calculation with its supporting evidence before the claim is authorized through the company’s tax-filing process.

execution.rationale: The technical owners and tax adviser review the study and supporting digital records before accepting the proposed credit treatment.

parts.title: File the credit claim with the tax return
parts.guidance: Reconcile the claim forms and required schedules with the supporting calculations, research records and filing-year instructions. If the company is making an election the regime offers, make it on the return the rules require. Resolve the intended treatment before submission and complete the signature and filing requirements for that entity’s return. Preserve the filed claim and acceptance evidence so any later offset application uses the elected amount and actual filing date.

geoResolutions.label: Attach Form 6765 to the federal income-tax return; an eligible payroll-credit election must be made on a timely original return
File the relief on the CT600 after the mandatory additional-information form
Claim the CIR with the corporate tax return
Claim SIFIDE II with the Modelo 22, on ANI's certification
Claim the Forschungszulage with the tax return via ELSTER, on the BSFZ certificate
Claim SR&ED with the T2 on prescribed forms
No credit claim to file since the 200% weighted deduction lapsed: R&D spend deducts at 100%, and DSIR recognition gates the remaining incentives
Claim the Enterprise Innovation Scheme enhanced deductions (400% on up to $400,000 of qualifying Singapore R&D, YA 2024-2028) in the Form C-S/C by the 30 November filing deadline
Register the year's R&D activities on the R&DTI portal, then claim the offset in the company tax return's R&D schedule
Claim the R&D credit on the corporate tax return through Hometax
geoResolutions.guidance: The research and manpower development credit under Restriction of Special Taxation Act Article 10 rides the corporate tax return, due within three months of the end of the business-year month (law rule kr.corporate-tax-return-deadline).

geoResolutions.label: The enhanced R&D deduction is claimed in the profits tax return: 300% on the first HK$2,000,000 of qualifying Type B expenditure and 200% above it
geoResolutions.guidance: Inland Revenue Ordinance Schedule 45 defines qualifying R&D activities and splits Type A (100% deduction) from Type B (300%/200%) expenditures; the claim rides the profits tax return rather than a separate credit filing.

geoResolutions.label: No profits return exists for an R&D credit to ride
geoResolutions.guidance: Corporate income tax is charged only when profit is distributed (law rule ee.corporate-tax-distributed-profits), so there is no annual profits return and no R&D tax-credit regime attached to one.

execution.rationale: The authorized tax filer reviews the credit treatment and submits the approved return and supporting claim through the accepted digital filing process.

parts.title: Apply any payroll offset the regime offers
parts.guidance: Where the regime lets the credit offset payroll or wage taxes, apply the election through the company’s existing payroll-filing process using the filed claim, the elected amount, and the actual filing date. Reconcile the credit used and the remaining carryforward each period, and keep the filed election evidence with the payroll records.

geoResolutions.label: Calculate the usable credit on Form 8974 and attach it to the employment-tax return: Form 941 filers start with the first quarter beginning after the income-tax return was filed; Form 943/944 filers follow the annual instructions

verify.how: The elected credit shows on the payroll or wage-tax returns and the payroll provider shows it offsetting employer tax on subsequent runs (in the US, Form 8974 carries it onto the employment-tax return).

execution.rationale: For the retained US Gusto method, an accountant administrator enters the filed credit and filing date in the documented tax-credit workflow. Gusto tracks quarterly use and carryforward with its payroll filings; the adviser retains eligibility and election decisions.

verify.how: Retain the applicable authority’s confirmation and reconcile it with the approved submission and company records.

metadata.supportReason: The qualifying-expenditure data pulls from payroll and accounting are automatable and a study provider drives the claim forms; the eligibility judgment, study review, and the return filing itself stay human.

geoNotes.summary: No US-style credit since the 200% weighted deduction lapsed: R&D spend now deducts at 100%, and DSIR recognition of an in-house R&D unit is the gateway to the remaining incentives (customs/GST concessions, government R&D schemes).
The UK analog is R&D tax relief claimed on the CT600 — a merged SME/RDEC scheme for accounting periods from April 2024, with a mandatory additional-information form before the claim.

The Forschungszulage (research allowance) refunds 25% of qualifying R&D wages — more for SMEs since 2024 — claimed in two steps: a project certificate from the BSFZ, then the allowance claim with the tax return via ELSTER.
France's CIR refunds 30% of qualifying R&D spend (with the CII for innovation on top), claimed with the corporate tax return — one of the most generous schemes in Europe.
The analog is SIFIDE II: a corporate-tax credit for R&D expenditure claimed with the Modelo 22, with the qualifying R&D certified by ANI (Agência Nacional de Inovação) on an annual application.

SR&ED is the closest thing anywhere to the US research credit — CCPCs earn an enhanced refundable credit on qualified R&D salaries and materials, claimed with the T2 on prescribed forms and defended with project records.

The analog is the Enterprise Innovation Scheme: 400% tax deductions on up to $400,000 of qualifying Singapore R&D per YA (2024-2028), claimed in the corporate tax return by the 30 Nov filing deadline, with a cash-payout conversion option for smaller spenders.

The analog is the R&D Tax Incentive: register the year's R&D activities with the Department of Industry, Science and Resources through the R&DTI portal, then claim the offset in the company tax return's R&D schedule.
The R&D tax credit (연구·인력개발비 세액공제, Restriction of Special Taxation Act Article 10) is claimed on the corporate tax return filed through Hometax.

The analog is the enhanced R&D deduction rather than a credit: qualifying Type B expenditure deducts at 300% on the first HK$2,000,000 and 200% above it (Inland Revenue Ordinance Schedule 45), claimed in the profits tax return.

countryViews.title: Claim the R&D tax credit
countryViews.summary: Claim the research-and-development credit your tax jurisdiction offers: scope the qualifying expenditure, run the study, attach the claim to the tax return, and apply any payroll offset the regime allows. In the US the claim is Form 6765 with the Form 8974 payroll-tax offset, worth up to $500k a year for pre-revenue startups.
